title: Transcriptional profile of naive CD4+ T cells with miR-31 inhibition
description: To describe the global profile of genes regulated by miR-31, we compared the transcriptomics between miR-31 silenced and antagomir control treated naive CD4+ T cells.

samples.title: Human sample from Homo sapiens
attributes: Primary peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMC) were isolated from whole blood by Ficoll separation. Nave CD4+ T cells were then isolated using human nave CD4+ T cell isolation Kit (Stemcell). Cell purity was >95% as determined by flow cytometry.
